items.title: Deere Shares Fall 3.8% as Fourth-Quarter Earnings Miss Expectations Despite Stronger-than-Forecast Revenue
items.summary: Deere & Company (NYSE:DE) shares declined 3. 8% in premarket trading on Wednesday after the agricultural and construction equipment manufacturer reported fourth-quarter earnings below analyst expectations, despite revenue exceeding forecasts.

items.summary: Investing.com -- Deere & Company (NYSE: DE) reported fourth-quarter earnings per share of $3.89, missing the analyst consensus estimate of $4.03 by $0.14, as the company wrapped up fiscal year 2026.
